text: {"class":"fixable","chokepoint":[{"operator":"page reads through the asynchronous I/O layer","component":"asynchronous I/O layer","frozen":true,"why_every_version_executes_it":"The predicate LIKE '%qz%' on an unindexed note column needs a full scan of the orders table B-tree, and every page read passes through the frozen I/O layer.","least_work":{"amount":4394,"unit":"pages","per_unit_cost_us":0.5,"total_ms":2.2,"calling_context":"warm OS page cache, a single scan of the orders table, cheapest per-page read path"},"max_cores":1}],"floor_ms":2.2,"L_delta":-4.72,"rationale":"About 61% of Turso's 3.7 billion instructions are in exec_like. This is VDBE code, which the contract leaves mutable.
